subject: Request: One-off PLG-waiver — 45-day complimentary runway for Novara POC
messages:
From: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@novarahealth.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request — procurement delay, need a short runway extension

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Novara team is excited about the latency gains on our triage workflows. Procurement is slower than expected and our initial sandbox tokens will run out before PO issuance. Can Redwood extend the complimentary POC window by ~45 days and provide an incremental 250k tokens of free usage so we can finish the evaluation?

We can provide an updated mutual action plan and a brief usage report if helpful. Procurement says an MSA signature is likely by the end of December but there’s a gap where results could stall without more runway.

—Claire
Claire Hsu
Head of ML, Novara Health
claire.hsu@novarahealth.ai
+1 415-555-0123

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@novarahealth.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request — procurement delay, need a short runway extension

Claire —

Appreciate the heads-up and congrats on the progress. I attached the usage export (novara-poc-usage-20271101.csv) — shows they’ve used ~160k tokens so far, peak latency tests look good. I’ll escalate this internally; we often hit policy limits on PLG credits but I’ll propose a one-off runway boost tied to conversion milestones.

Will loop in our deal desk and leadership to request a 45-day complimentary runway + 250k token uplift.

Best,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Novara runway request — ask for one-off PLG waiver (RDW-3289)

Folks — forwarding Claire’s note and the attached usage export. Quick summary: Novara (healthcare, HIPAA-adjacent but not live yet) has procurement delays; without an extra 45 days and ~250k complimentary tokens they’ll be unable to complete an evaluation that’s already showing strong perf. Conversion probability looks high (CRO touch after pilot).

Ask: One-time PLG waiver to add 45 days to their sandbox window and 250k tokens of free usage. Constraints I propose:
- Approval tied to a signed mutual action plan (MUP) within 10 business days of the extension start.
- If no MSA signed by 2027-12-31, complimentary usage stops.
- We capture brief case-study permission and a logo (marketing) on conversion.

Attachments: novara-poc-usage-20271101.csv

Reasoning: preserves momentum, avoids lost pipeline, low incremental cost relative to expected ARR. If approved I’ll offer the terms to the customer and request a DocuSign addendum.

Thanks — Marcus

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Novara runway request — ask for one-off PLG waiver (RDW-3289)

Marcus —

Thanks for the context. I’m supportive of an exception if we tether it to concrete milestones. Please capture the following before we surface to Vivek for final sign-off:
- MUP that lists specific deliverables + deadlines (Novara commits to a tech validation milestone and a procurement check-in).
- Minimum conversion threshold: 30% of their projected pilot consumption converted to committed ARR in first 90 days post-MSA (we can agree language).
- Accounting note: tag complimentary usage as "Marketing/Onboarding Credit — One-off" and limit visibility in billing to CO-managed buckets.

If you can produce the MUP draft and the updated usage attach, I’ll prep a short note for Vivek.

—Marissa
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2027 14:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Novara runway request — ask for one-off PLG waiver (RDW-3289)

Team — after reviewing the usage and likelihood to close, I approve a one-time PLG waiver under these exact conditions:
1) 45-day extension to the complimentary sandbox window + up to 250,000 free tokens (no cash transfer).
2) Novara signs the MUP within 10 business days of extension start and executes our standard MSA amendment (DocuSign) by 2027-12-31.
3) Legal to include a stop clause that halts complimentary usage automatically if MSA not countersigned by 2027-12-31.
4) Marketing gets a case-study opt-in at conversion.
5) Accounting to tag credits as one-off marketing/onboarding.

Marissa — please confirm wording for the MUP and accounting tagging. Marcus — once Laura (customer) signs the MUP, please send doc to contracts@redwood.ai with deal id RDW-3289 and copy me.

Approved — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni, CRO
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@novarahealth.ai>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@novarahealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request — One-off PLG-waiver — 45-day complimentary runway for Novara POC

Claire / Tom — great news: leadership has approved a one-time extension. Summary of approved terms below (as agreed internally):
- 45-day complimentary sandbox extension starting 2027-11-10.
- Up to 250,000 additional free tokens to cover the evaluation runway.
- Conditions: Novara signs the attached Mutual Action Plan within 10 business days of 2027-11-10 and executes our MSA amendment by 2027-12-31. Complimentary usage will be disabled automatically if MSA is not countersigned by 2027-12-31.

I’ve attached the MUP draft (novara-mup-20271108.pdf). Please review and sign the MUP; once you do we’ll kick off the extension and I’ll route the MSA to your procurement team via DocuSign.

DocuSign (MSA amendment) link to follow once MUP is countersigned. Let me know if you need revised milestone text — happy to iterate quickly.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.
Marcus
Attachments: novara-mup-20271108.pdf
